extDescription.message: Shows the estimated greenhouse gas emissions of your conversations with an AI chatbot, in real time.

badgeAriaLabel.message: Emissions for this conversation: $AMOUNT$. Click for details.

dashboardConversationTooltip.message: Estimate. Method: tokens × emission factor. Uncertainty margin of a factor of 3.

onboardingQuestion.message: To refine the estimate of your emissions, tell us where you are mainly based:

onboardingExplanation.message: In France, models hosted in Europe are counted at the French grid mix (30 gCO2e/kWh); US-hosted models keep their own datacentre factor. You can change this at any time from the dashboard, and it never leaves your device.

onboardingDone.message: Saved. You can close this tab: the Carbomètre badge will appear on claude.ai, chatgpt.com and chat.mistral.ai.

dashboardMonthToDateLabel.message: Since the start of the month

locationChangeWarning.message: Responses already counted are never recalculated: the new location only applies to the next responses. If a total went up between two looks, a new response was counted.

optionsIntro.message: Everything stays in your browser: no data leaves your machine, exports included — they are plain downloaded files.

optionsLanguageNote.message: Applies the next time claude.ai, chatgpt.com or chat.mistral.ai pages are loaded.
